_comment: Example order store for ipo-trigger-low mode

_instructions.mode: Set to 'ipo-trigger-low' for buying at lower prices when market drops
_instructions.trigger_logic: If price >= limit: use price with -9%/-10%; else use limit with -8%/-9%
_instructions.calculation: Conditional decrements based on price/limit comparison
execution_flow: 2. If price >= limit: use price with -9% (trigger) and -10% (order)
3. If price < limit: use limit with -8% (trigger) and -9% (order)
4. Monitor LTP until LTP <= trigger level
_instructions.example_1: price=1000, limit=900 → use price (1000) → trigger=910 (-9%), order=900 (-10%)
_instructions.example_2: price=1000, limit=1100 → use limit (1100) → trigger=1012 (-8%), order=1001 (-9%)

orders._comment: Uses price (1000) with -9%/-10% since price > limit. Triggers at 910, orders at 900
Uses limit (1100) with -8%/-9% since limit > price. Triggers at 1012, orders at 1001
Scheduled execution at 11:00 AM. Uses price (1200) with -9%/-10%. Triggers at 1092, orders at 1080
